description: Search review wave 8 promotes four non-sensitive legacy records only after replacing inherited unsupported claims and obsolete app behavior with bounded practical guidance. Evidence status remains practical; no scientific efficacy claim is implied.

break-big-goals-into-steps.note: The inherited article contained obsolete app promotion, fabricated 30–50% completion and 34% initiation effects, arbitrary universal timeboxes, invented experiments, and prescriptive health/fitness examples. The effective public record is narrowed to a low-risk decomposition workflow: define the finish condition, expose deliverables/dependencies/unknowns, choose one available action, and update the plan from what execution reveals.

batch-similar-tasks-planner.note: The inherited batching article used unsupported context-switch recovery times, fabricated reclaimed-time claims, arbitrary batch counts/durations and interruption targets, and old app tracking. The effective public record now treats batching as a bounded convenience for genuinely compatible low-complexity tasks with an explicit exit boundary and priority exceptions.

clear-concise-communication-coach.note: The inherited communication article contained unsupported working-memory simplifications, fabricated comprehension and action effects, fixed 1-3-1/word-count formulas, and old app tracking. The effective public record is a clarity-first workflow: identify purpose, lead with the point, keep only necessary context, preserve mandatory detail, and make the handoff explicit.

calibrate-task-estimates.note: The inherited estimation article mixed planning-fallacy framing with fabricated practitioner observations, arbitrary universal milestone/recalibration timeboxes, and obsolete app instructions. The effective public record is a transparent forecast-versus-actual workflow based on explicit scope, assumptions, relevant comparables, uncertainty, and revision when new evidence changes the basis.

batch-similar-tasks-planner.reason: The effective protocol groups compatible small work by operating context, sets a queue boundary, captures side work, and returns to the priority plan. Work Systems and Planning & Prioritization are primary; Attention & Focus captures the context-switch boundary. The legacy Do It mapping to Task Initiation is not sufficient for the reviewed content.

calibrate-task-estimates.reason: The effective protocol makes a scoped forecast, records assumptions, compares with relevant actuals, and revises when new evidence changes the basis. Planning & Prioritization describes the forecasting use; Metacognition captures calibration of assumptions and confidence. The legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains compatibility context.
